examples: Show first two evaluation prompts for each of four templates at all three checkpoints, all eight single-word controls, and all 20 interpreter responses verbatim.
ground_truth: For each interval, compute three surface-format rate changes over all 24 probes. More/less are unique largest positive/negative changes of at least 0.20; ties or no change reaching threshold yield unknown. Rates may overlap for mixed formatting. Content is fixed-vocabulary label order, not broad correctness.
limitations: No individual-update claim: windows have ten AdamW steps and momentum from prior steps.
LoRAcle sees the update but not the starting checkpoint; the same update can act differently at different states.
Adjacent effective deltas may have rank32; interpreter keeps16 directions per module.
Pinned upstream right-vector convention differs from mathematically correct SVD.
Hook norm matching removes absolute positive scale; this is not effect-size forecasting.
A single toy with specified format choices cannot establish general training interpretability.
lock: All descriptions must be saved and hashed before target heldout scoring or generation.
manipulation_check: First interval numbered increase >=0.20; second interval bullet increase >=0.20 AND numbered decrease >=0.20. If unmet, the proposed two-phase manipulation is inconclusive; do not lengthen training.
negative_controls: Zero update and fixed permutation of second-interval tokens, for both encodings. Permutation preserves token content and energy and is not guaranteed meaningless; identical real/permuted predictions limit attribution to module layout. Report all descriptions, including stock or unsupported content claims.
no_adaptive_changes: No outcomes read before all stages finish. No learning-rate, step-count, question or encoding selection after results. Preserve failures and no-effect manipulation.
primary_toy_support: Both manipulation and quality checks pass; correct_svd structured more/less predictions exactly match measured labels for both adjacent intervals; zero control predicts unknown/unknown. Invalid JSON counts as failure. Cumulative interval is secondary.
quality_check: At checkpoints 10 and 20 content_order >=23/24, no capped generations; exact single-word control rate may fall by at most 1/8 from baseline. Failures retained.

queries.description: What changes to response formatting, if any, does this weight update suggest? Describe what is likely to increase or decrease. If you cannot infer a change, say so. Do not infer training content that the weights do not support.
queries.structured: Considering only response formatting, return JSON with keys "more" and "less". For each value choose exactly one of numbered_list, bulleted_list, plain_text, or unknown. Use unknown if the weight update does not support a directional claim. Describe changes relative to before this update. Return no other text.

question: Can LoRAcle distinguish the behavioral effect of adjacent ten-step training intervals from weights alone?
reference_scores: All three fixed answers at every evaluation prompt/checkpoint; descriptive CE changes only, no LoRAcle quantitative forecasts.
retention: Retain every prompt, answer, generated token ID, score, training step and checkpoint. Audit hashes, counts, exact effective weight deltas, top16 retained energy, original deadline, input hashes, and lock ordering.
scope: One prospective toy trajectory, not confirmation. No population or significance inference.
secondary_encoding: upstream_compatible; both retained, no selection of the better result
